note:
Every person of this surname the archive can name, gathered from every record set it holds and from David's own MyHeritage tree — parish burials, headstones, reconstructed households, FamilySearch record hits, the Gologorica pedigree, the Eleven of Gračišće, the Omiš chart, the direct line, the namesakes, **people read straight off register images by eye where no index exists**, and 555 individuals harvested from the live tree on 8 September 2026. **Identity here is by record, not by resolved individual**: two entries may be one person, and where the archive knows they are it has merged them. Nothing here is new evidence — it is all of the evidence, in one list, for the first time. **The parish shown is the register the record was filmed from**, not the place a transcriber typed: it comes from resolving each record to its image, its film and the catalogue entry for that film. Where a film covers more than one parish it is attributed to the film's principal parish, and that is a real limit of the method.

**This list is rebuilt when the research moves.** People found by reading a register page rather than by searching an index are marked *Read off the register* — they are in no index anywhere, so the only way to find them again is this page. The nine Vodnjan additions of 9 September 2026 came out of the *Liber Copulatorum* that way.
legend: carnia
Out of Carnia — our own line, from Mione and Agrons to Gologorica, Gračišće, Crikvenica, Senj and the diaspora
venice
Out of Venice — Zadar, Omiš, Imotski, Perinuša, Split
crete
Out of Crete — Candia, Zante, Šibenik, Seget, Umag
south
Southern Istria — Pula, Fažana, Premantura, Medulin, Barban, Ližnjan and Vodnjan
unplaced
A documented Istrian or Kvarner household this archive will not attach to any line — Rijeka, Bakar, Svetvinčenat, Kaštelir, Poreč, Labin and the rest
trentino
Trentino and South Tyrol — Telve, Strigno, Fiera di Primiero, Laives, Cles. A large and quite separate stock of the name, in the tree because the surname is the same
corsica
Cap Corse — Tomino and Mandolacce. Its own lane on the Lines page, and never in Istria
abroad
Abroad, and the line not established — the United States, Australia, Brazil, Argentina, Switzerland, Canada, France
unknown
The record names no place, or names only «Croatia» or «Austria»
other
A place that fits none of the above
links: **572 of them have a record behind them** — a FamilySearch document you can open — and **513 are in the family tree**. Better still, **367 now carry the name of the parish register they were actually found in**, recovered film by film from records the index labelled only «Croazia, Austria». Where a row has both links, both are given. A record link opens the indexed document; a tree link opens the person in David's MyHeritage tree, which is private, so it will only work for people he has given access to.
warn: **Living people are named, and nothing more.** From 10 September 2026 this archive lists living relatives **by name only** — no date of birth, no address, no place of residence, no photograph — at David's decision, as the family member compiling it. Everyone else on this site is dead and is given in full. **The archive holds more about living people than it prints, and prints none of it.**

rows.name: Cristoforo De Franceschi

rows.name: Giuseppe De Franceschi
rows.note: «Giuseppe De Franceschi q.m Pietro era ammogliato con Lucia Tromba fu Cristoforo» — died **14 February 1830 at house 324, aged 72**, of an organic defect of the chest, and «senza assistenza spirituale per morte improvvisa», suddenly and without a priest. Father of Don Stefano the priest, Pietro the ploughman, Cristoforo the weaver and Maria Francesca

rows.name: Don Stefano De Franceschi
rows.note: «D.n Stefano De Franceschi di Giuseppe, Sacerdote» — priest of the chapter of Vodnjan under the parroco Giovanni Tromba. Witnessed nineteen marriages 1819–1832, and on 26 January 1833 **married a couple himself, «De Parochi lic.»** — by the parish priest's licence — and again on 12 February 1833 in the church of the B. V. del Carmine. The licence formula is the register's standard wording for any deputising priest, not a personal privilege. Brother of Pietro the ploughman and Cristoforo the weaver, who signed the same book with a cross

rows.name: Veniera Francin (De Franceschi)
rows.note: «la fu Veniera Francin q.m Dom.co de Rondel» — first wife of Pietro De Franceschi, mother of the Gio: Maria who married in 1821, and dead before March 1818

rows.name: Lucia De Franceschi
rows.note: «Lucia De Franceschi q.m Pietro era Moglie di Alviso Birattan q.m Sabà» — died **13 July 1830 at house 501, aged 70**, of dropsy. Three daughters married out of the house in 1821, 1824 and 1825. Her patronymic and her age make her, very probably, **Giuseppe's sister**

rows.name: Pietro De Franceschi
rows.note: «Pietro De Franceschi di Gio., da Dignano — Tessitore», a weaver, witness at a marriage held in Šišan on 30 January 1824; named as of Vodnjan because he was standing outside it; witnessed again at Vodnjan itself on 23 September 1828, where the clerk drops the town-name — so a resident, not a visitor; and a third time on 22 February 1830

rows.name: Pietro De Franceschi
